title: Canva client ids, placeholders, references and prefix prose
summary: A public client id, placeholders, environment references and masked values under client_secret, and prose that names the cnvca prefix.
rationale: A client id is a public application identifier and is not the secret. A placeholder, reference or masked display carries no value, and the sentence that names a prefix describes the format without holding a value. Flagging them would redact identifiers and documentation a reader needs.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged under project policy: these inputs hold no secret value. That a client id is public and that a placeholder or reference is not a value are the project's decisions, not Canva statements.

sources.supports: client_secret string Optional Your app's client secret, for authenticating the request. Begins with cnvca .
Before authenticating to the REST APIs, you must first create and configure your app in the Developer Portal, including: ... Generating and saving a client secret

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy.
